## Description

Clearly describe the bug and what is going wrong.

> **Example:** The application crashes when a user submits the form without entering a location.

## Steps to Reproduce

List the steps needed to reproduce the bug.

> **Example:**
> 1. Open the application
> 2. Leave the location field empty
> 3. Click "Submit"
> 4. Observe that the application crashes

## Expected Behavior

Describe what you expected to happen instead.

> **Example:** The application should display an error message asking the user to enter a location.

## Actual Behavior

Describe what actually happened.

> **Example:** The page crashes and displays an internal server error.

## Screenshots or Error Messages

Add any screenshots or error messages that help explain the problem.

> **Example:**
> ```text
> ValueError: location cannot be empty
> ```

## Possible Solution

If you have an idea of what may be causing the bug or how to fix it, describe it here.

> **Example:** Add input validation before the form data is processed.

## Additional Context

Add any other information that may help someone understand or reproduce the bug.

> **Example:** The issue only occurs when the location field is completely empty.
